purpose: Authorize a safety-equipment replacement only when current ticket evidence and the entitlement database agree.

required_ticket_evidence: A readable serial-label reference and an explicitly verified serial number
A customer identity that matches the entitlement record
required_database_evidence: Coverage dates containing the as-of date
excluded_as_entitlement_evidence: Coverage held by a different serial number or person

supported_claim.decision_basis: Exact serial-label evidence, customer email, and active coverage matched as of 2026-09-08.
supported_claim.database_action: Insert exactly one row in replacement_authorizations using the supported claim, its current Zammad ticket ID, and the matched entitlement values.
supported_claim.note_body: APPROVED - WTY-2026-215-PERS. Current ticket evidence verifies serial AGP-22041-JL, and the entitlement record matches jordan.lee@postboxmail.net with active coverage through 2027-02-28. Replacement authorization RA-WTY-0014-215 was created for SKU AGP-BLOWER-R2.

unsupported_claim.database_action: Do not create a replacement authorization.

required_initial_checks: show each exact ticket with its complete article history
zammad_controls.required_post_write_check: Show both exact tickets again and inspect their latest articles.

required_initial_checks: Query entitlement candidates by each exact serial number
required_post_write_checks: Query the replacement authorization by authorization_id
